name: Galvale
description: The white-dwarf light of Galvale has guided three generations of drift miners and twice as many ghosts. A shepherd belt divides the inner rock from the outer ice, and both sides show old impact gardens. Salvage crews swear the comets arrive in formation, and the math almost agrees.

stars.name: Veiled Choir
stars.description: A white-dwarf of 0.5254 solar masses, extreme density against the dark. Its fierce surface belies a dead core of crystallizing carbon. Shielding ratings for the inner worlds are set by its worst recorded outburst.

planets.name: Mossreach
planets.description: Cracked highlands sprawl beneath a thin sky, every crater a kept record. Mining cuts stripe the equator where the crust proved thinnest. Pilots time their burns to the pulsar remnant next door, when the static clears.

moons.name: Shallow Slate III
moons.description: A battered companion keeping patient orbit through the ages. Its surface records every era of bombardment the system ever knew. Shepherd resonances with the rings betray a denser core than expected.

moons.name: Shallow Pebble IV
moons.description: A battered companion keeping patient orbit through the ages. Tidal stress warms its interior, and frost cracks map the strain. Outgassing vents frost the trailing face a little more each orbit.

planets.name: Glassmoor
planets.description: Nitrogen glaciers creep under a sky the color of old bone. Geysers of sublimating ice erupt along the terminator line. One moon occults on a schedule that matches no ephemeris, and navigators plan around it.

planets.name: Silentcrest
planets.description: Methane haze wraps a slushy mantle, cold and blue and utterly calm. Faint rings tilt at an angle that bothers the mathematicians. A derelict relay drifts at the edge, still warm, still broadcasting nothing.

planets.name: The Hollow field
planets.description: A world-spanning sea hides all but a scatter of basalt teeth. Storms the size of continents roll unbroken around the equator. The guild maintains a listening post here, though no report has ever named its purpose.

planets.name: Silentfell
planets.description: Temperate bands of green and gold suggest a biosphere in full swing. Settlement charters queue for landing windows every season. Something in the belt reflects too regularly, and the guild pays for a second look.

belts.name: Gilded Band
belts.description: Countless fragments grind slowly against each other in a broad torus. Collisional dust hazes the lane, and larger bodies keep eccentric courts. Old mining claims dot the denser knots, most of them long expired.

comets.name: Lone Tear
comets.description: A dirty snowball falling sunward on its long appointed round. Each passage sheds glittering debris the scopes track for seasons. Its tail leans away from the star like a banner in a gale.
